title: Roasted Cauliflower, Parsnip and Leek Crêpes
changes_from_base: The plain crêpes become a savoury main course: unsweetened crêpes rolled around roasted cauliflower, parsnip and leek bound in a mustardy stock velouté enriched with egg yolks, then baked under more sauce.
summary: Hearty savoury crêpes rolled around roasted cauliflower, parsnip and leek, baked under a silky yolk-enriched sauce.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
cauliflower (1 small head), in small florets
fine sea salt or table salt
small leeks, white and pale green parts, halved lengthways and washed (about 300 g)
parsnips (about 3), quartered lengthways, woody core removed
vegetable stock (check stock label for celery)

steps.title: Crepes
steps.text: Whisk 210 g flour with ½ tsp salt, whisk in 4 eggs and half of 540 ml milk to a smooth paste, then stir in the rest of the milk and 45 g melted butter; rest the batter 30 min, then cook 12 thin crêpes in an oiled 25 cm pan, about 1 min a side, and stack them.

steps.title: Roast
steps.text: Heat a roasting tin in a 220°C oven, toss 900 g cauliflower florets with two-thirds of a mix of 42 g melted butter, 80 ml olive oil, ½ tsp pepper and 2 tsp mustard powder, season with 1½ tsp salt, then roast for 10 min.

steps.title: Add
steps.text: Toss the halved leeks and 340 g parsnips with the remaining butter-oil mix and 1 tsp salt, turn the cauliflower, add the leeks and parsnips to the tin and roast for 20 min, turning halfway.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Lower the oven to 160°C and roast until everything is golden and tender, 20-30 min, then chop all the vegetables into 6-12 mm pieces.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Whisk 3 egg yolks with 2 tbsp cream in a bowl, simmer 720 ml vegetable stock in one pan, and in another cook 42 g butter with 3 tbsp flour over medium-low heat for about 3 min without browning.

steps.title: Thicken
steps.text: Off the heat whisk the hot stock gradually into the butter and flour until smooth, return to low heat for 2-3 min until slightly thickened, then whisk into the yolk mixture and return to medium-low heat until steaming, 2-3 min, without boiling.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Set aside 240 ml of the sauce and stir the rest into the chopped roasted vegetables.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.text: Butter a baking dish, spoon the filling along each crêpe, roll up and lay seam-down in the dish, then spoon over the reserved sauce.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake at 180°C until bubbling at the edges and hot through, about 20 min, checking the centre of the filling reaches 74°C.

tips: Mustard powder is a recognised allergen, so check this suits everyone before serving.
Check the stock label for celery if that is relevant for your guests.
Keep the egg-yolk sauce just steaming rather than boiling, as it can split if it gets too hot.
storage: Serve this bake hot from the oven; let any leftovers cool, then keep them covered in the fridge and reheat in the oven until piping hot throughout. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
